Second release candidate of nitpicker, a quality gate for code written by coding agents. It narrows each language to one allowed way of doing each thing and fails a change only for the problems it adds.

This is a pre-release: rules, messages and config keys can still change before 0.1.0. It is not on npm yet; install it from the tarball attached here.

## What's new since rc.1

- A Go preset, Kotlin on Maven, and Kotlin Multiplatform and Android modules.
- `npx nitpicker init` sets a project up: config, install command, agent skill and CI.
- A GitHub Action, a config JSON Schema, a rule reference with `nitpicker explain` and `nitpicker rules`, and `--json` output.
- Many more rules in every preset, for tests, data access, concurrency, logic, regular expressions and Spring. Only the findings a change adds fail it; existing code stays baselined.

The full list follows.

## Presets

- `typescript` (default), with React rules
- `javascript`
- `python`
- `java`, with Spring rules, on Gradle and Maven
- `kotlin`, on Gradle and Maven
- `go`

## Install

Node.js 22.14 or newer and a Git repository. In your project's folder:

```sh
npm install --save-dev https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc.2/nitpicker-0.1.0-rc.2.tgz
npx nitpicker init
npx nitpicker
```

`init` detects the language, writes `nitpicker.config.json` and prints the peers to install and the agent skill for your preset.

To pin the exact file and check it, download it with its checksum and keep it in your repository:

```sh
gh release download v0.1.0-rc.2 --repo jhonDoe15/nitpicker --pattern 'nitpicker-*.tgz' --pattern SHA256SUMS --dir vendor
(cd vendor && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS && rm SHA256SUMS)
npm install --save-dev ./vendor/nitpicker-0.1.0-rc.2.tgz
```

## Agent skills

The tarball carries one skill per preset. Install the one for your project:

```sh
npx skills add ./node_modules/nitpicker --skill nitpicker-typescript
```

See the [README](https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/blob/v0.1.0-rc.2/README.md) and the [usage guide](https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/blob/v0.1.0-rc.2/docs/usage.md) for configuration, CI setup and adopting nitpicker on existing code.
